in_sanskrit.name: Yesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God, Jyestha
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Yesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The Sanskrit name Yesh is derived from the word Jyestha, which means elder, superior or eldest. This name is associated with God and is considered to be a sacred and powerful name.
